    An evening full of chocolate, sugar and moments of happiness awaits you – that's All You Can Sweet! 🍭

    On 13 November, you'll have the opportunity to enjoy as many sweets as you like for CHF 5.

    Look forward to waffles, crêpes, tiramisu, crumble and chocolate mousse – most of which are vegan or have a vegan option. Plus lots of little treats to snack on. 🍫

    Mulled wine, punch and hot chocolate will also ensure the perfect feel-good atmosphere – all as sweet and warm as the evening itself, of course. ✨

    And if you feel like helping with the baking or preparation, you are of course also very welcome to come along as a helper!

    • Ski Weekend from Friday onwards

    The cold season is upon us and you know what that means: it's time for another VMP Skiweekend! So put on some warm clothes and join us in Lenk from the 20.03-22.03 for an unforgettable experience! There will be fun activities, food and, of course, looots of skiing!

    If you register here we'll depart on Friday late afternoon, so that you can ski on Saturday and Sunday. And all of it for only 230.- CHF in the whole ski-region Adelboden-Lenk. Included in the price are train- and ski-tickets, overnight stay, as well as food and drinks.

    However this time you can even choose to ski a day more. In case you would rather already go on thursday, please register here:

    https://vmp.ethz.ch/de/events/skiwe_lang_2026/

    Die Anmeldung wird um Nov. 13, 2025, 6 p.m. .
    March 20, 2026, 6 p.m. Duration: 2 days, 0:00:00
    © 2023 VMP Impressum
